metadata.title: Goldman Sachs, Microsoft share gains lead Dow's 184-point jump - MarketWatch

content.text:
Dow Update
Goldman Sachs, Microsoft share gains lead Dow's 184-point jump
Shares of Goldman Sachs and Microsoft are seeing positive gains Thursday morning, sending the Dow Jones Industrial Average into positive territory.
Shares of Goldman Sachs Goldman Sachs Group Inc. and Microsoft Microsoft Corp. are contributing about a quarter of the index's intraday rally, as the Dow Dow Jones Industrial Average was most recently trading 184 points (0.3%) higher.
